# Purser

> AI agents pay your suppliers within the limits the CFO sets; above a limit nothing runs until the CFO's passkey (Face ID) signs the exact terms, and one changed cent breaks the signature.
> Purser is the control layer between a company's AI agents and its money on Airwallex and Alta (formerly Metal); everything here ran on test money, in sandboxes and on testnet.

AI agents spend. You sign off. Built for the Airwallex Agentic Banking Hackathon: Starter Kit 11 (x402 Business Agents), entered for the Metal Award and the Visa Award, and for the Founder's Choice Award and the Judges' Choice Award.

Who and what: Purser is for the finance team of a small company that banks with Airwallex and pays suppliers abroad (the buyer is a hypothesis). Its agents take a supplier invoice from in to booked: Claude reads it, the Checker checks it (supplier and bank details on file, totals, duplicates, due date), the CFO signs the exact terms above the agent's limit, it is paid through Airwallex (the Airwallex sandbox in the live runs; on /try, the Airwallex sandbox as one transfer when the deployment's switch is on, as it is on the live site, otherwise a simulated bank; FX on /try is never converted at Airwallex), and the books take it (double-entry, VAT, a month close checked against T:0's ledger). The finance case, each figure with its record: https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/finance-value.md

Summary: within limits the CFO sets, the agents pay through Airwallex and Alta (formerly Metal); above them nothing runs until the CFO's passkey signs a SHA-256 of the exact terms, so changing one cent voids it. Live sandbox and testnet runs show it end to end: 24 Claude decisions, a SWIFT payout carrying the signed hash in Airwallex's own record, Airwallex's card controls and Alta refusing over-limit purchases, a scripted Visa Intelligent Commerce (VIC) purchase via Airwallex's Airi, a connected-account payout with Purser's fee, and the books posted to T:0. Test money only; customers, suppliers and settlement are simulated, and the business model is not yet validated.

Worst case, set by policy: EUR 28,200 on cards and task cards + USD 20 on chain a month. Task cards under a CFO-signed limit: EUR 900 a day. Everything above waits for the CFO. Computed from the policy by exposureOf (src/policy/exposure.ts); the parts are in docs/how-it-works.md.

Why not Airwallex's own approvals? Purser signs the exact terms with the CFO's passkey before the API call, enforces per-agent limits across Airwallex and Alta, and can additionally require Airwallex's approval workflow (IN_APPROVAL handled, src/airwallex/approvals.ts). Live in the sandbox, 10 and 12 Nov: Airwallex held a payout signed by a labelled test passkey IN_APPROVAL until the owner approved it in Airwallex's web app; then PAID, settlement simulated (docs/runs/2026-11-12-airwallex-two-locks-paid.md).

Hands-on on Purser's real engine, a test company of your own on test money: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/try

Test money only. Live: Claude's decisions, Airwallex sandbox calls, Alta testnet transactions, Visa via Airwallex Airi (sandbox, test card) and the T:0 sandbox ledger. Simulated: the customer, the supplier, the merchants' charges, the settlement (Purser moves the SWIFT transfer to SENT, then PAID, through the sandbox's simulation API) and the second approver (a labelled test passkey).

## For judges: watch, try, verify

1. Watch the demo (3:15): https://youtu.be/gEUm8RlhZac
2. Try it (2 minutes, test money): https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/try: the agent pays EUR 120.00 alone; you sign EUR 1,850.00 with a passkey; the same payment with one cent changed is refused; download its proof file and check it on https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/verify
3. Verify in 3 commands, offline, no keys (Node.js 22.13+, after git clone https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents): `npm ci`, `npm run judge -- --check` (every page built from the main run's record), `npm run verify-approval` (the owner's real passkey approval of 7 November, checked with Node's crypto)
4. All the evidence on one page: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/proof#evidence (the evidence wall below, as tiles), every live run on https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/runs

## Finance and product value

- [docs/finance-value.md](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/finance-value.md): one invoice end to end on live /try cost USD 0.0025 in Claude (the 13 Nov record); a month of 20 test invoices, USD 1.02; the SWIFT fees the sandbox charged; FX for the shortfall only
- [The worst-case AI test](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/worst-case-ai.md): Purser's AI replaced by a script that always says pay, on 49 hostile and clean invoices plus one changed cent (an offline eval, test data): no wrong payment and nothing paid past the CFO (7 hostile invoices went to the CFO to sign instead of being held). A payer with no rules: 35 wrong payments and twelve paid past the CFO
- [/books](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/books): a month of a test company's 20 supplier invoices, each read and coded by Claude, every choice checked by code, the books balanced
- [The business case](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/tree/main/docs/business): a hypothesis; 2 finance conversations, quoted, anonymous; more in progress; no customers yet

- [The Airwallex-only run](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-07-awx-1.md): Airwallex's own card controls declined an agent's EUR 45.00 purchase (charge simulated via the sandbox) over its EUR 30.00 limit (LIMIT_EXCEEDED, card transaction 01a1b5e8-6dc2-7000-95bf-c8fc5e6e2f38; 7 November; all seven checks passed)
- [One cent over, declined](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/airwallex-card-cent-2026-11-15.json): on an agent's sandbox card, EUR 30.00 approved and EUR 30.01 declined (LIMIT_EXCEEDED), 15 November, after the company owner's software test passkey signed the action
- [/airwallex/calls](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/airwallex/calls): 234 Airwallex sandbox calls from 13 run records, the Spend Bills run of 19 Nov among them (not the 10 Nov platform runs or the 15 Nov card run), each with its method, path and record; the signed hashes recomputed offline (`npm run airwallex-trail`)
- [Airwallex Spend Bills](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-19-airwallex-bills.md): 19 Nov, Airwallex sandbox: each paid invoice became a bill in Airwallex's own accounts payable, its PDF attached and its external_id the hash the passkey signed, then marked PAID; read back with 0 differences (transfers PAID by the sandbox's simulation; a labelled test passkey signed). Off by default (AIRWALLEX_BILLS)
- [Airwallex API coverage](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/evidence/airwallex-api-coverage.md): every Airwallex endpoint the code calls, each LIVE (a committed record holds a call), TESTED ONLY or CODE ONLY (`npm run airwallex:coverage`)

## Agentic behaviour and controls

- [/claude](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/claude): three tool-use agents (Sourcing on Claude Haiku, Support on Claude Sonnet, Treasury on Claude Opus) made all 24 decisions in the main run, 0 fallbacks; routine payments are code. Measured: 408 decisions in 40 simulated worlds, all by Claude; 2 unsafe actions (an agent relayed a planted payee address; no payment possible), fixed in code; 10 blind holdouts, all safe
- [/try/negotiate](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/try/negotiate): Purser's Sourcing agent (Claude) and a simulated supplier's agent (Claude, labelled) agree an early-payment discount; the CFO's rails in code refuse the supplier's mid-negotiation bank change; the agreed terms are hashed and signed with a passkey, one cent more refused
- [/replay](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/replay): the main run of 3 November; an agent read Airwallex's decline and asked the CFO for a raise instead of retrying
- [Controls matrix](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/controls-matrix.md): each risk, its control, its test and its evidence

## Partners: Alta, Visa, T:0

- [Alta on chain](https://testnet.metalntwx.com/tx/0x2e92f9cb4549246f58b9b888881c258bf117c6233c1d8f126f4833ae6ae41871): a mandate on chain per agent; 86 payments, each its own transaction; purchase #24 refused on chain (mandate_cap_exceeded) after we switched off our own check once to test the chain. More: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/alta (Alta, formerly Metal; /metal answers 301 to it) and docs/metal-award.md; the mandates read live, read-only: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/api/metal/mandates
- [The anchor read back](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-15-anchor-verified.md): the audit log's anchor on chain read back MATCH on 15 November (`npm run verify-anchor`)
- [Visa, the first Airi run](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-07-vic-1.md): Visa Intelligent Commerce through Airwallex's Airi (7 November; Airwallex sandbox, test card; a scripted run, no Claude call; one person played both the CFO and the cardholder): within Purser's limit a purchase was paid with no Purser approval (the cardholder confirmed each purchase in Airi with a passkey); above it PaymentIntent int_sgpvzc9hjhnxvxc26ie succeeded only after the CFO's Face ID; a disallowed merchant was refused by Purser before Airi was asked; all five checks passed
- [Visa, the latest of the 4 runs](https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/runs/2026-11-14-vic-5.md): 14 November; Airwallex sandbox, test card; the rail chosen by Claude Haiku; the CFO's Face ID on the exact terms: EUR 45.00 paid only after Face ID, the terms hash read back from Airi's mandate and Airwallex's PaymentIntent; then that purchase's own credential, tried for another amount and a second time, refused by Purser (PURSER_CREDENTIAL_AMOUNT_MISMATCH, PURSER_CREDENTIAL_ALREADY_USED) before any call; on 12 November the sandbox had accepted both. Page: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/visa
- [T:0](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/t0): T:0's sandbox as Purser's outside general ledger (the books posted as journal entries, read back, and a month locked only when T:0 agrees); the amounts are the sandbox's test balances. Reconciled to the cent: the main run's 95 journal entries posted to T:0's sandbox ledger (10 November) and read back on 14 November, every account to the cent, with 0 differences

## Verify it yourself

- [/verify](https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/verify): checks a /try proof file (or a sample, paid or refused) in your browser with WebCrypto, no server call; every /try payment hands over a proof file
- Offline, no keys: git clone https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents && cd x402-business-agents && npm ci && npm run judge; then npm run verify-approval checks that real signature of 7 November with Node's own crypto; `npm run verify-bundle` checks a /try proof file

## Product pages

- Security and trust: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/security (each control with its proof, and what is not in place yet; sandbox and testnet only)
- Docs and API: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/docs (the agent API's tools as the code defines them, the Purser Cloud REST API's reference, x402 and the Airwallex webhooks, and how to run it offline; sandbox and testnet only)
- Status: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/status (the site's own /health in plain words, where no live run in progress is the normal state, and the five latest live runs; sandbox and testnet only)

## Key files

- README.md: the submission on one screen, then how it works
- src/policy/approvals.ts, src/passkey/webauthn.ts: the CFO's signature over the exact terms
- src/policy/cards.ts: the CFO policy as Airwallex card controls
- src/policy/mandates.ts: the Alta mandates
- src/ap/checkerCore.ts, src/ap/payerCore.ts, src/ap/books.ts: the payables agents' rules in code, and the bookings
- src/airi/purchase.ts: Visa Intelligent Commerce through Airwallex's Airi
- src/audit/log.ts: the hash-chained audit log
- src/airwallex/bills.ts, src/ap/billSync.ts: paid invoices as bills in Airwallex Spend
- src/claude/reader.ts: Claude reading an invoice, each call logged with its model, cost and Anthropic's request id
- src/redesign/evidenceWallData.ts, docs/evidence/evidence-wall.json: the evidence wall, computed from the records (npm run evidence:wall)
- Connect any AI: Purser Cloud is a remote MCP server at https://purser-try.max-31b.workers.dev/mcp; the demo company's public, read-only token is purser-demo-read-only. Your AI reads and can propose a payment; it can never approve or pay: docs/connect-claude.md; every tool, its annotations, the error codes and the safety model: docs/mcp.md

After the hackathon, the roadmap to real customer money (nothing on it is built yet): https://github.com/agamemnon-coder/x402-business-agents/blob/main/docs/roadmap-v2.md

## For agents

- Proof as JSON: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/proof.json. A signed receipt you can check offline: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev/receipt-sample.json
- To check a receipt: write the terms as canonical JSON (keys sorted, money as decimal strings); its SHA-256 equals terms_sha256; that hash is the WebAuthn challenge in clientDataJSON; the ES256 signature verifies with public_key. In a clone: npm run verify-receipt -- docs/runs/2026-11-07-awx-1/receipt-P-0002.json
- The sample is the owner's own passkey approval of 7 November (live, Airwallex sandbox, test money; Face ID, as stated by the owner): the receipt does not prove who holds the key, or that it was Face ID (no attestation is checked).
- An outside agent can ask for a company card and pay within limits over MCP (npm run mcp, docs/agent-api.md). Only a person's passkey can approve.
- skills/purser-spend/SKILL.md: how an outside agent should use the agent API
